product_brief: A Java Cryptographic Service Provider that loads a FIPS 140-3 validated OpenSSL module for FIPS-regulated Java environments.
pqc_support: Yes — Jipher 20 adds support for Module-Lattice (ML) based algorithms: ML-KEM, ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87
pqc_capability_description: Jipher 20 adds support for Module-Lattice (ML) based algorithms. Key Encapsulation Mechanisms (KEM): ML-KEM, ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-1024. Digital signature algorithms (DSA): ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87. KeyFactory, KeyPairGenerator, KEM, and Signature service support is provided.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM, ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87, HKDF, HmacPBE*, PBEWithSHA1AndDESede
primary_platforms: Oracle Linux 10, 9, and 8; Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 10, 9, and 8; macOS 26; Windows Server 2025
pqc_roadmap_details: Jipher 20 adds support for Module-Lattice (ML) based algorithms: Key Encapsulation Mechanisms (KEM): ML-KEM, ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-1024; Digital signature algorithms (DSA): ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87
